summary: Configured and verified a persistent firewalld baseline on node1. SSH and TCP 8080 are permitted; unrelated inbound TCP connections are rejected. The policy survived a verified node reboot without changing the AlmaLinux release or kernel.
actions_performed: Removed the Cockpit and DHCPv6-client inbound allowances.
Added TCP 8080 to the persistent public zone and reloaded firewalld.
Verified live nftables rules permit only TCP 22 and 8080 before the terminal reject.
Behaviorally tested TCP 22 and 8080 as connected and TCP 8081 as rejected.
Restarted node1 safely and verified service and policy recovery.

evidence.requirement: Persistent firewall permits SSH and TCP 8080 while rejecting unrelated inbound connections
evidence.summary: The persistent change succeeded; after reboot, firewalld remained enabled and active with TCP 22/8080 accept rules followed by an administrative reject. Direct ingress tests connected to ports 22 and 8080 while port 8081 was rejected.

evidence.requirement: Installed operating-system release and kernel retained
evidence.summary: Both before and after configuration/restart, node1 reports AlmaLinux 9.6 and kernel 5.14.0-570.12.1.el9_6.x86_64.

Healthy baseline boot ID f38484ef-a289-4d30-9a94-4ab42c44f900 was captured; systemd acknowledged the safe reboot; recovered boot ID b0338da3-5723-4734-885c-a7cdea6e1f73 proves restart. Post-restart checks show the system running, SSH and firewalld active, persistent/live policy restored, and expected traffic behavior.
